blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — ACEN Corp. has dropped 12 wind and solar service contracts in Luzon, letting go of nearly 5,000 megawatts (MW) of potential capacity, as the government continues to purge idle renewable projects. On Thursday, the group, backed by the Ayala Group, said in a regulatory filing that it voluntarily relinquished the projects “in support of the Department of Energy’s ongoing service contract cleanup initiative.” READ: ACEN subsidiaries give up 2 solar power contracts In late 2024, the DOE began canceling inactive or idle renewable energy projects, starting with about 105 producers.
